prompt.project_info: Create a clean social-media-ready Mediterranean travel portrait with bright whites, saturated blue, and pink bougainvillea.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with long light-brown soft waves and a soft smile with playful confidence. She wears a white cropped open-knit crochet top with flared sleeves, a high-waisted blue tiered maxi skirt, black sunglasses on her head, a dark red shoulder tote, and holds a disposable coffee cup.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter-body vertical portrait, slightly angled side-back view, subject slightly right of center with white wall edges and walkway leading the eye. She stands relaxed with torso turned back and gazes over her shoulder. Show white stucco walls, vivid blue door and window frames, stone pavement, pink bougainvillea, quiet coastal-village atmosphere, and mostly focused background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright crisp top-right natural daylight, defined shadows, high-key exposure with clear detail, clean white architecture contrasting with blue, pink, red, and black accents, lighthearted sunny summer mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical travel lifestyle portrait, standard focal length with mild background compression, sharp subject focus, minimal bokeh, clean high-resolution clarity, realistic crochet, cotton, stucco, wood, stone, and petal textures, no typography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Bright airy Mediterranean travel lifestyle portrait of an adult woman with long light-brown soft waves, standing relaxed with her torso turned back and looking over her shoulder toward the camera with a soft smile and playful confidence. She wears a white cropped knit top with open crochet pattern and flared sleeves, a high-waisted blue tiered maxi skirt with soft drape, black sunglasses on her head, a dark red shoulder tote worn on her back, and holds a disposable coffee cup. Vertical three-quarter-body side-back view, subject slightly right of center, white wall edges and stone walkway leading the eye. Whitewashed stucco walls, vivid blue door and window frames, pink bougainvillea, quiet coastal village. Bright crisp top-right sunlight, defined wall and ground shadows, high-key clean whites, saturated blue and pink accents, standard focal length, sharp subject, minimal bokeh, no text.
